value.rationale: The quantitative discrepancy between continuum many distinct station/ergodic-joining regimes and the exact O(1/q) uniform Wasserstein collapse directly tests whether recently proposed limit-set networks retain statistical information under product formation. The result reconstructs the complete joining simplex as a metric space for all p, determines a sharp all-joining radius and exposes a concrete lower-semicontinuity failure; not merely a classical graph-joining existence claim. Its limitations are made explicit.
